First-time setupPrepare your ARM input deviceARM INPUT
  1. 1 · Prepare

    Linux, Python 3, systemd and SSH. Use the board’s USB data/OTG port. The OS must expose a keyboard gadget, usually /dev/hidg0.

  2. 2 · Install

    Use trusted SSH keys, or download the complete package for manual/password-only installation. No PC server or Node.js is needed on ARM.

  3. 3 · Connect

    Connect the board to Switch, then check the connection. Installing the agent does not configure board firmware or type anything on the console.

First connect from a terminal and verify the board’s host fingerprint. Use ssh-copy-id USER@ARM_IP to authorize an existing key. Passwords stay in your terminal; private keys stay on this PC.

Download the complete ARM package below, or copy packages/iz2s-arm-input.tar.gz from the platform folder. Enter SSH passwords in your terminal.

scp packages/iz2s-arm-input.tar.gz root@ARM_IP:/tmp/
ssh root@ARM_IP

On ARM:

mkdir -p /tmp/iz2s-input-setup
tar -xzf /tmp/iz2s-arm-input.tar.gz -C /tmp/iz2s-input-setup
cd /tmp/iz2s-input-setup/arm-input
sudo python3 install.py --folder /opt/iz2s/arm-input

Use your actual SSH account. Non-root accounts need sudo for manual installation. The bundled README includes prerequisites, troubleshooting, offline copying and removal.

Choose LAN or Wi-Fi for each network device.

Connect devices to the same local network. USB input uses its own cable.

Warning: Existing code in slot 0 may be overwritten. Back up anything you need first.

Choose an empty slot. Its contents will be edited; saved files change only after Save. After restart, Launch loads the saved file into slot 0.
